pr_title: [Fastlane.swift] generate Swift API for third party plugins and local actions
pr_body:
Related https://github.com/microsoft/fastlane-plugin-appcenter/issues/43
Fixes #14940

### Motivation and Context
Fastlane.swift users have been without actions and plugins for too long 😱

And with the HockeyApp end of life the functionality being transferred to a Microsoft App Center plugin, we need to allow Fastlane.swift users to migrate over if they were using the `hockey` action 🏒

### Description
- `fastlane generate_swift` - only available if a Fastlane.swift project
  - Automatically gets run on `add_plugin` and `update_plugins`
  - User needs to manually run when creating/updating external (local) actions
- Split `SwiftAPIGenerator` into separate generators
  - `SwiftAPIGenerator` is the base class
  - `SwiftFastlaneAPIGenerator` generates the `Fastlane.swift` file of all _fastlane_ actions and global parsing actions
  - `SwiftActionsAPIGenerator` generates the `Actions.swift` file for loaded external (local) actions
  - `SwiftPluginsAPIGenerator` generates the `Plugins.swift` file for third part plugins

#### Demo - Plugins
![fastlane-swift-plugins](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/401294/63267152-0bf41680-c257-11e9-8d1e-52d19e9ff3b6.gif)

#### Demo - Actions
![fastlane-swift-actions](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/401294/63266991-bf104000-c256-11e9-8bc3-da9a9d7511de.gif)


### Testing Steps

#### Plugin
1. `bundle exec fastlane init swift`
2. `bundle exec fastlane add_plugin ascii_art`
3. `fastlane/swift/Plugins.swift` should have action for `asciiArt()`
4. Update `fastlane/Fastlane.swift` with a call for `asciiArt()`

#### Actions
1. `bundle exec fastlane init swift`
2. `bundle exec fastlane new_action fromSwift`
3. `bundle exec fastlane generate_swift`
  - Enter `from_swift` as the name
4. `fastlane/swift/Actions.swift` should have action for `fromSwift()`
5. Update `fastlane/Fastlane.swift` with a call for `fromSwift`
